items.summary: An open-source (Apache-2.0) desktop app from DIYgod, creator of RSSHub: on macOS, Windows or Linux, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP agent can operate a real iPhone (iOS 17.4+) or Android phone (Android 10–17) over USB or Wi-Fi; on Android 13+ the agent works on a hidden second screen while your phone stays locked; payments and transfers are blocked by default in the gateway until you click Allow, so an agent cannot approve itself; away from home it reaches Android phones over Tailscale. 1,800+ stars in five days.
items.title: Pinky: Let AI agents use your real iPhone and Android phone — an open-source MCP desktop app with Wi-Fi pairing, Tailscale remote and payments that wait for your OK (released Nov 6)

items.summary: An open-source Live2D companion for Windows: a character who talks in real time, keeps long-term memory and can be given a home city, with speech, voice synthesis, memory and vision all running locally; the language model can use OpenRouter or run fully locally through Ollama (27B and up), with optional smart-home, Discord, Telegram and Tailscale hooks. The code is MIT-licensed, the character art and voice are under a personal-use license, and it needs an NVIDIA GPU.
items.title: OpenAmika: A locally run Live2D AI companion that talks, remembers, and hooks into your smart home (surfaced Nov 5)
